title: Scalar associativity on the profinite slice
statement: For every commutative condensed ring Lambda [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and every profinite S, the fixed profiniteScalarRealization [def-zl-condensed-lisse-evaluation-model] is naturally isomorphic to moduleDerivedExtension along the actual profiniteScalarMap followed by Evaluation.F on the slice over S. No extremal disconnectedness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Use the derived coefficient-slice comparison, before constant realization, and precompose it with constants from R. Localize the proved ordinary constant-slice comparison to replace restricted constants by constants on the slice.

The direct slice coefficient map is by construction the composite of the constant ring map R->A and the terminal coefficient counit. Apply the proved scalar_associator to the three fixed universal cochain models and reverse its isomorphism.

Identify the cochain model for the constant ring map with the adjoint-defined derived extension: the ordinary coefficient adjunction, K-flat resolutions and the cochain-derived-adjunction theorem give the same right adjoint, so uniqueness identifies their left adjoints. Apply the constant-realization derived scalar comparison and whisker with the terminal coefficient extension and internal-module equivalence. Compose the five natural isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: HRS equations (3.1)-(3.2), Remark 3.2; Lean assembly using coefficient-slice restriction, fixed-model scalar associativity and constant-realization comparison.
